narrative.details:
Wrenched from its hulking corpse, the goliath's bracers are massive. Your whole arm, up to the shoulder, can fit through one without touching the sides.

You should bring these back to Hammerfall, as a warning. Drum Fel ought to know what he's up against.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Goliath's Wristguards to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
